reason: The smine-apply step-4 casual lockout applies only to a skills-kind proposal targeting an existing skill. The same step's context-kind routes edit shipped skills: the eviction route rewrites a skill's context: frontmatter, and smine-context/smine-memory declaration amendments edit skills/<path>/SKILL.md acdsl-context:. Neither route is gated, while smine-orchestrate L41 treats any edit to a non-origin: user SKILL.md on a casual install as a hard breach. Spec item correctness-97 requires that no run-branch commit touch a non-origin: user skill on casual installs.
